scope: offline protocol evidence only; no runtime request, no database
input: controlled store of one executed text/CSV plan (card-verification.test-fixture.ts); protocol values, not property facts

part2.table: usp_property_card_revocations: primary key (card_id, revision), foreign key to usp_property_cards(id, revision), update and delete refused by trigger
decisions: revocation asks for the creator, access view and policy only; no plan authority and no expiry, so a card stays revocable after its sources or expiry moved on
a second request key answers with the first revocation and writes no row, receipt or event
reasonCode is a caller-chosen lower-case code (^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$); no fixed list of reasons is decided
revocation is per exact revision: other revisions of the card still read, and a card takes a new revision when its latest revision is not revoked
the report takes the revocation by row key, so it is reported even when the card body failed its check

schemaSafety.additiveOnly: one new table, one new function, one trigger on the new table, one ledger row; no existing table, row, index or function is altered
schemaSafety.idempotent: ledger-guarded inside the single migrateUsp transaction under the usp-migration-ledger advisory lock; schema and mark commit or roll back together
schemaSafety.lock: the foreign key takes a brief SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE lock on usp_property_cards; no row is rewritten or scanned beyond the empty new table
schemaSafety.oldApiOnMigratedDatabase: unaffected: readiness ignores relations it does not expect, so the step can run before the code is rolled
schemaSafety.sqlExecutedReason: no PostgreSQL offline; the SQL was checked by reading, by the manifest verifier and against the card-table triple it is modelled on

unmigratedDatabase.health: GET /api/v1/health: databaseReadiness.status schema_missing, schema.ready false, schema.missingRelations [public.usp_property_card_revocations], schema.missingMigrations [usp_property_card_revocations_001]
unmigratedDatabase.platformStart: pnpm platform:start --profile demo throws "Demo schema missing after explicit bootstrap migrations." (scripts/platform/processes.mjs waitForApi)
unmigratedDatabase.cardRoutes: generate, read, resolve, verification and revoke reject on the revocation lookup (SQLSTATE 42P01), answered as 503 USP_REQUEST_FAILED by the evidence filter; nothing is disclosed and no card row is stored
unmigratedDatabase.houseNote: no request-time named code for a missing relation exists in this codebase; the named answer is the readiness report, as for every other migration

accessAuthority: row.subject equals the caller subject, else 403 CARD_ACCESS
plan reader on row.plan_id/plan_version: creator, access view, policy, source and target access
row.site_id/manifest_id equal the scope of that plan, else 403 CARD_ACCESS
plan and source authority taken again after the object reads; the card body is read by none of these

runtimeRequest.owner: runtime worker, once the Tower 3 card exists
runtimeRequest.cardId: from the generate response; the QR holds this URL without /verification
runtimeRequest.expect: 200; data.result consistent; six pass checks; lifecycle.latestRevision 1, superseded false, expired false; signature.state not_assessed

gaps: store double covers a text/CSV plan only; no report test runs a PDF-plan card (the Tower 3 case)
the chain links revisions by number; the card schema holds no predecessor hash
a transient 409 inside the packet reader is reported as packet_bytes fail, not retried
revocation not run live and its SQL never executed; the first execution is the roll-out runner
the older card test doubles answer only the expiry column, so they do not model revocation
a card whose stored body fails its integrity check cannot be revoked (409), since the creator is read from it
on a database without the table a refused generate may leave one unreferenced PDF object, as any refused final publication does
database/README.md does not list the new step (not an owned path)
